content.text: This confirms both locations exactly match. Commit 74ab99c refactored `getValues()` and `streamAllWithData()` by extracting the Spliterator-building logic into private helper methods (`valuesStream`, `allWithDataStream`), but wrapped the `ResultSet` acquisition in `try-with-resources`, closing the ResultSet before the lazily-evaluated Stream/Spliterator could consume it — exactly the bug that commit 8acbfba fixes by removing the try-with-resources and adding comments explaining the ResultSet must stay open.
